tasks.commitBody:
The season-manage panel gains a repertoire section: the managed
season's repertoire items listed with work + edition labels, remove
controls, and the existing add-work select ('Lisa teos…' + Lisa,
composer labels per #204) — season repertoire is now manageable
without hunting for an unprogrammed event. Per-event works lines
and their 'repertoire'-context fallback are unchanged (still the
entry point for event editors without season rights).

Interpretations for the live gate (issue flags both correctable):
'programme management' read as season repertoire management; the
section scopes to the PANEL's season (manageableSeasonId) and its
rights, so it manages the same season the rest of the panel does —
including the future-only and lapsed-current divergence cases.

New heading key season_manage_repertoire_label in all four locales;
everything else reuses the existing repertoire_* keys.
